findings.text: Phaser getFrame() returns the __BASE frame for unknown names, so every missing-art guard was drawing the entire 2048px atlas across the scene.
Tile families were keyed by leaf name, so tile/woods/grass_* merged with tile/town/grass_* and the town field rendered as a two-tone checkerboard.
Grass variants were tone-mismatched and non-periodic, producing visible per-tile seams and brightness checkerboarding.
Flagstone path pattern is mechanical and too light against the grass; needs irregular stone shapes and a warmer, dirtier tone.
Scaffold map only: large empty grass fields, no landmark hierarchy, buildings not yet integrated into terrain.
